relations: Celia（叙述者）；Harriot（同行/救人者）；包工头（前史，未涉）
numbers: 感恩节清晨；脚伤不止一月；Hogscald 就在眼前

facts.fact: 感恩节清晨霜 crunch；Harriot 盯她：「你穿牛仔裤」「满身惊喜——别担心，我喜欢」
facts.anchor: It’s just that you’re wearing jeans.
facts.verbatim: It’s just that you’re wearing jeans.

facts.fact: 空校园剩学生稀如冬叶；Harriot 主动说听见过下面「大动物」（一夜、又一次近墓地）
facts.anchor: I thought I heard something down there
facts.verbatim: I thought I heard something down there

facts.fact: Celia 安抚：野猪不上校园（人太多）；老径苍白如袜带蛇；她童年只挣得 chiggers 与细枝
facts.anchor: They never come on campus, though.
facts.verbatim: They never come on campus, though.

facts.fact: 她穿旧靴、吃止痛片；Harriot 眯眼如珠宝商验石：「那就带路，old sport」
facts.anchor: the look of a jeweler examining a stone for faults
facts.verbatim: the look of a jeweler examining a stone for faults

facts.fact: 小径细如脊柱；每步皆赌；Harriot 绊倒压上她背，她掌擦岩壁稳住
facts.anchor: it ran as thin as a spine
facts.verbatim: it ran as thin as a spine

facts.fact: 转身太近、脸距几寸；她的眼与早冬天空同一种汹涌的灰；「这让我热身了」；乌鸦互喊
facts.anchor: the same tumultuous gray of the premature winter sky
facts.verbatim: the same tumultuous gray of the premature winter sky

facts.fact: 半小时激动的沉默；脚刺→真痛（猫抓般麻刺、白等麻木）
facts.anchor: Cat-scratch tingles ran up and down the sole of my foot
facts.verbatim: Cat-scratch tingles ran up and down the sole of my foot

facts.fact: 她跳过根丛攀裂石——脚失力、踝侧折、肘下巴着地、滑进失重空气
胫撞凸岩、兔子颤、枯叶蘑菇味；Harriot 一步一咒赶到跪旁
facts.anchor: Rabbit trembles broke out all over my body
facts.verbatim: Rabbit trembles broke out all over my body

facts.fact: 她的一切轰鸣：雀斑/短方指甲/红褐发在阳光歌唱——「从没这样感激；几乎爱她」
「不值得拿命换」「这就是我的命」；Harriot 挑眉「回程路上慢慢想」拖她上山
